name: HameLive! ~Idol Parallel~
original_name: ハメライブ！ 〜アイドルパラレル〜
source:
The protagonist is a young billionaire at the top of a major Japanese conglomerate, and he dates top idols and popular school idols. However, the world is in crisis due to an evil organization, so in order to protect their daily lives, he teams up with the Pretty Cure heroines to confront them.

[Edited from [url=https://dl.getchu.com/i/item48915]DL.Getchu[/url]]
